integrity: The product map and inverse are written explicitly on the unique p12 big-cell chart.
Integral homology is derived by Alexander duality and the integral Kunneth theorem, not by finite sampling.
The source premise and its d=4 Euler value were checked in Example 4.12 and Table 5.
limitations: Specific to the labeled four-coordinate cycle instance p12, p14, p23, p34 in Gr_C(2,4).
No classification of arbitrary cycle arrangements or real complements is claimed.
The mixed Hodge structure is not determined beyond the compactly supported Hodge--Deligne polynomial.
title: Product structure and integral topology of the four-cycle Schubert complement
